channel.title: mrhakan's shithole
channel.description: a retro y2k personal site — winamp, guestbook, minesweeper, trolls and all. best viewed at 800x600.

item.title: v3.0 — the personal web update
item.description: Added the classic personal-web pages: /now, /uses, /colophon and a changelog. Plus an 88x31 button wall with a link-to-me badge, a shrine of favourite things, an internet-history timeline, a full site map, a "which track are you?" quiz and this very RSS feed.

item.title: v2.0 — 55+ apps, games and effects
item.description: Minesweeper, snake, pong, paint, notepad, calculator and a working MS-DOS prompt. My Computer, recycle bin, control panel with 7 wallpapers and a dial-up simulator. 23 achievements, 12 screen effects, magic 8-ball, visitor poll and site statistics.

item.title: v1.5 — windows error remix
item.description: End every process in the task manager and the Windows XP error sound becomes a rhythmic beat while error dialogs cascade across the screen. Also: live repo demos in fake Internet Explorer windows, and a guestbook powered by GitHub pull requests.

item.title: v1.0 — the shithole opens
item.description: A Windows 98 desktop on the web: taskbar, start menu, BIOS boot screen, a Winamp player with a real audio visualiser and per-track themes, canvas matrix rain, the konami code and a troll invasion.
